data.long_meaning: The name Ismile is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ish' and 'Smile'. Ish is the name of the supreme God in Hinduism, while Smile represents happiness and contentment. This name signifies the divine presence of God in one's life, bringing joy and happiness. The name Ismile carries the meaning “Smiling IS (God)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ismile usually hope their child will grow to embody smiling is (god) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
